method: Separate fresh implementation batches inspected at most four candidate/reference pairs each. Existing C3 PNGs were diagnostic inputs. No local application, prototype, test, build, probe, or SSH verification was executed.

batches.changes: Anchor the complete white page-jump surface and top rule; add the centered incognito policy notice; draw one selected navigation indicator without the extra long segment. Preserve balanced grids, page contexts, navigation, and the closed-reader exception.

Restore unavailable splitting structure, the current whole-spread state, true cover-alone controls, black enabled contrast controls, and a visible empty-bookmarks state with the actual current-page action. Keep orientation labels truthful for single/double/automatic layouts and preserve existing reverse-landscape, per-book hint, reverse-tap, input-epoch, and display-ready contracts.

Restore Paperwhite preview spacing and the 150 px preview; provide individual accurate unavailable reasons for unsupported policies, visible logging status, 118 px Scribe log actions, and a readable two-line device capability summary.

Measure real native label widths with a dedicated intrinsic layout, use stable contiguous pagination, preserve distinguishing suffixes for an oversized single label, and use check/cross state markers. Expose intrinsic-width and matching measurement/render text-weight inputs for shared summary/detail use. Accessibility roles are constant and decorative labels do not invent actions.
batches.remote_gate: The Slint intrinsic-layout getter, actual measured columns, first/final page reachability, and native glyph rendering require the C4 remote build and fresh screenshots.

batches.changes: Render four real storage components, a bar only for a known scale, actual top-five records and totals, and accurate loading/partial/empty states from RAM State. Restore disabled category affordances and an immutable Uncategorized row. Wrap actual paths and expose the implemented full-path detail action. Separate dashed creation from solid management actions and preserve real repository pagination/removal.
batches.data_boundary: The scale describes tracked image data plus available filesystem space, not device capacity. Unknown components stay unknown; no UI filesystem/database query or fixture amount is introduced.

batches.changes: Prevent opaque pagers from covering queue/summary side and bottom rules. Include actual content, pagination, spacing, and padding in each surface; keep upward page-jump overlays above the frame. Use shared TagFlow for complete summary labels. Preserve native glyphs and wrapping while spacing book-summary lines to 32 px and adding a first-segment two-em rendering indent without mutating source text.

Use checked-square/folder library glyphs and correct Scribe detail action glyphs/gutters while preserving Paperwhite plain-text menus, real action IDs, disabled states, press inversion, confirmation dispatch, and outside capture.

prior_c4_local_repairs_preserved: Library filter labels use the context-specific 16 px Paperwhite size and bounded widths without changing catalog tags.
Empty source preferences have an explicit contained Paperwhite sheet/Scribe popover with a real close action and an accurate empty declaration.
Source picker display names and compact connection states preserve the full accessible source name.
The current-book download-removal confirmation predicate remains connected to its real action.
The true three tap maps, independent reverse-tap preference, and cover-alone preference remain connected.
The redundant root parent-width binding in settings-tap-card.slint was removed; callers retain explicit dimensions.

coordinated_external_ui_work.contract: Library owns divider draw order. Detail uses the shared native TagFlow with 36 px items, 15 px text, weight 400, 16 px horizontal padding, 8 px gap, intrinsic widths, and at most four preview rows. More than four actual tags are previewed as the first three plus a visible remaining-count disclosure opening the full summary; the full State tag collection is preserved.

verification_boundary: Implementation dispositions are not finding closures. Root must build the complete frozen C4 source remotely, capture the complete reference/supplemental scope, and obtain two consecutive fresh clean rounds. Candidate3 reports and PNGs remain unchanged.
